capabilities: Set local images as wallpaper via drag and drop
Adjust opacity and Gaussian blur sliders
Apply contrast and darkness overlays for text legibility
Render the background through GPU-accelerated CSS custom properties
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's personal note admits the core code was partly AI-generated ('vibe coded') in its original form.
motivation: The author wrote an earlier version three years ago but never published it because local images did not work; this release finally publishes that project.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a custom background image in the workspace, especially from local files without running a web server.
summary: Wallpaper plugin that sets a local or remote image as the Obsidian background via CSS variables, with opacity, blur and overlay controls.
